title: Kagamine Rin — Adding My Message!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Exhale*
How was my dancing just now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were really solid up until that turn!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. The way you moved your arms was so dynamic I couldn't look away♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks!
That means all that training with Haruka and Shizuku is paying off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But I know I can still do better...
Mind watching again from the top?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe!
Airi sure is motivated today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. She's always doing her best, but things are different this time around...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She said that she got Haruka and Shizuku to teach her stuff, and now they're all training together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But she's even practicing here...
Which is astounding to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think seeing her work like this makes us all want to do better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think I'll start training too...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No! I don't think... I'm going to!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I also want to spread cheer and hope to more people as an idol... I know there's lots more I can do!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I like your spirit!
I'll join you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you have a training regimen in mind already?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh?
Uh... I actually haven't thought of anything yet...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, we'll help you come up with one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We do want you to become the most wonderful idol you can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, let's brainstorm!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your strengths involve always being cheerful and full of energy, Rin!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're an expert at getting the audience going with big movements and gestures. So, let's try maximizing your potential there!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Maximize my potential? How do we do that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There are multiple ways to approach this, but let's try working on your sense of rhythm in singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Learning how to maintain a steady rhythm should allow you to sing better and create a nice flow!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Let's try that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know this isn't easy, but try to maintain this posture.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hnnng! Th-This is so hard...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Your face looks scary, Rin.
Don't forget that you're an idol. You gotta smile.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hnng... Smile... Smile... Hnng...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: M-My body keeps shaking!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's cap things off today with the most intense strength training ever!!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Starting with some squats!
You'll be doing... As many as you can until I say, “Stop!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Until she says, “Stop!”...?!
She's gonna make me do so many...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Airi's doing her absolute best...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: O-Okay, I'll try...!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice work, Rin.
Congratulations on making it all the way through!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That means we can go even harder tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: E-Even harder...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll be able to handle that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
B-But I'll do my best!
Like Airi's been doing!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's the spirit, Rin!
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice work, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, Luka!
Is Airi done practicing?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, she finished just a second ago and went home.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?
I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's proof that you were focusing on your own training.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, why did you decide to start training all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, seeing Airi practice super duper hard also made me want to do the same...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I hope you're able to make Airi feel the same way someday!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? The same way?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just as Airi made you want to do your best, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She might see you practicing really hard and feel that she needs to also keep trying. Wouldn't that be wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi? After seeing me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, that would be wonderful!
I wanna help Airi as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In order to help everyone, I'm gonna keep doing my best again tomorrow!
